name: tektite
description: A static site generator for Obsidian vaults that renders each hashtag as an explorable room of concepts.

scripts.dev: npm run build && node dist/cli.js build
scripts.demo: npm run build && node dist/cli.js build test/vault -o test/out --watch --serve
scripts.test: node --test test/graph.test.mjs test/rooms.test.mjs test/autoroom.test.mjs test/attachments.test.mjs test/home.test.mjs test/label.test.mjs test/watch.test.mjs test/build.test.mjs
